description: Every country one reporter traded a commodity with in a year, ranked by value, each with the implied unit value it paid or received. Use for 'where does Ghana sell its cocoa and at what price to each buyer' and for comparing prices across markets. Pass the reporter as ISO alpha-3 (GHA, IND). Annual data. Completeness is verifiable for this shape: the response says whether the partner rows reconcile with the upstream's own World total.

commodity.description: Instrument code with an HS heading. Example: CC for cocoa.

reporter.description: Reporting country, ISO alpha-3 preferred. Example: GHA.

name: trade.partners

complete.description: Whether the partner rows reconcile with the upstream's World total

notes.description: Caveats the numbers cannot carry. Read these before presenting a unit value.

partner_count.description: Partners the upstream returned, before any limit

unit_value_catalog.description: The same figure in the instrument's own catalog unit, or null when there is no honest mass conversion (crude, gas and the grains price by volume or count).

unit_value_usd_per_kg.description: Average realised price implied by this row (value / net weight). NOT a benchmark or spot price — it reflects the grades and terms that actually traded, and will differ from price.latest. Comparable across the rows of one response only.

title: Trading Partners Ranked
